description: Logical symbolic control-word schema for version 1 CPU control.

attributes.purpose: Load AC at TP.
Loads the CIFP register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the DF register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the DIF register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the EA_ADDR register.

constraints.text: Must not conflict with other EA writers

attributes.purpose: Loads the IB register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Enables the selected source to drive the internal datapath bus (IDB).

constraints.text: Must be asserted when IDB_SRC is used
Only one source may drive the IDB per cycle

attributes.purpose: Loads the IE register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the IF register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the II register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Loads the IOT_TRANSFER register at TP.

constraints.text: May be asserted only during external-IOT EXECUTE.
At TP2 or TP3, it may capture an accepted transfer request.
At the commit TP of a pending transfer, it clears the completed transfer or replaces it with a newly accepted transfer.
A transfer accepted at TP2 executes during TS3 and commits at TP3.
A transfer accepted at TP3 executes during TS4 and commits at TP4.
It uses a direct load path and does not involve the ALU or IDB.

attributes.purpose: Loads the IR register.

constraints.text: Requires valid instruction present in MB

attributes.purpose: Loads the Link (L) register.

constraints.text: Typically used with ALU operations affecting carry or rotate

attributes.purpose: Loads the MA register.

constraints.text: Must not conflict with other MA writers

attributes.purpose: Loads the MB register.

constraints.text: Must not conflict with other MB writers

attributes.purpose: Loads the MQ register.

constraints.text: Requires a valid source driving IDB when used

attributes.purpose: Increments PC via ALU.

constraints.text: Requires ALU to be configured with:
ALU_OP = INC
ALU_A_SRC = PC
Must not be asserted simultaneously with PC_LOAD

attributes.purpose: Loads the PC register.

constraints.text: Must not be asserted simultaneously with PC_INC
Exactly one source must drive PC input when asserted

attributes.purpose: Selects the address source for memory reads and writes.

constraints.text: Drive must be asserted via either /RD or /WR

attributes.purpose: Selects the input source for AC.

constraints.text: ALU is the source for all arithmetic/logical AC loads via the IDB
DB is the source for I/O data ingestion (DB_READ_TO_AC); the DB value is OR'd into AC
Field-merge encodings OR the selected field into its DEC-defined AC bit positions and preserve all other AC bits:
IF, DF → AC[5:3]
IB → AC[5:3] (saved IF), AC[2:0] (saved DF)
MQ replaces AC in full (AC ← MQ), not a merge or OR; used by AC_MQ_SWAP
GTF_FLAGS is ORed into AC and is used only after AC_CLEAR has committed at the preceding TP.

fields.name: ALU_A_SRC
fields.value_required_when: Any micro-operation listed below is selected

attributes.purpose: Select primary ALU operand.

constraints.text: Must be valid every cycle
Required for all ALU operations

fields.name: ALU_B_SRC
fields.value_required_when: Any micro-operation listed below is selected

attributes.purpose: Select secondary ALU operand.

constraints.text: NONE required for unary operations

fields.name: ALU_OP
fields.value_required_when: Any micro-operation listed below is selected

attributes.purpose: Defines ALU computation.

constraints.text: Result valid only if captured by a load signal

attributes.purpose: Selects the source input for DF.
Selects the source input for DIF.
Selects the source input for EA_ADDR.

constraints.text: IDB path requires IDB_DRIVE asserted

attributes.purpose: Selects the source input for IF.
Selects which source drives the internal datapath bus (IDB).

constraints.text: Requires IDB_DRIVE = 1
Exactly one source selected per cycle
Reserved values must not be used

attributes.purpose: Selects the operation applied to the Link (L) register.

constraints.text: ALU_CARRY only valid during ALU operations producing carry
AC[11] loads the pre-TP value of AC[11] into L without modifying AC.

attributes.purpose: Selects the input source for MA.
Selects the input source for MB.

constraints.text: IDB path requires IDB_DRIVE asserted
MDB path used for memory reads

attributes.purpose: Selects the data source used for driving MDB.

constraints.text: Must contain a valid encoding in every control word

attributes.purpose: Selects the field register that drives the Memory Field Bus (MFB) as EA_FIELD for memory operations.

constraints.text: Selects the MFB driver during CPU-initiated memory operations
Governs the address field only; must not be conflated with data-side selects (MDB_SRC)
Console EXAM/DEP use MFB_SRC = IF
During MS = DMA, the CPU does not drive MFB; MFB_SRC has no effect

attributes.purpose: Selects the input source for PC.

constraints.text: When PC_LOAD = 1:
selected source must be fully driven and valid

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value to load into the CIFP register.

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Provides externally sourced I/O data into the CPU.

constraints.text: Must be stable when sampled
No effect unless explicitly consumed

attributes.purpose: Represents the value loaded into DF

constraints.text: Only used when DF_SRC = Control

attributes.purpose: Provides the implemented PDP-8/E processor flags word to the AC input path.

constraints.text: GTF_FLAGS is a combinational datapath value and is not stored state.
/INT_REQ must be synchronized and stable when GTF_FLAGS is consumed.
GTF_FLAGS has no effect unless AC_SRC selects GTF_FLAGS and AC_LOAD is asserted.
GTF_FLAGS is ORed into AC.
AC must have been cleared at the preceding TP when GTF_FLAGS is consumed by GTF.
Observing /INT_REQ does not acknowledge, clear, or consume any controller interrupt condition.

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value to load into the IE register

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

fields.name: IF_DF_COMBINED
fields.value_required_when: Any micro-operation listed below is selected

attributes.purpose: Represents the concatenation of IF and DF
Represents the value loaded into IF

constraints.text: Only used when IF_SRC = Control

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value to load into the II register

constraints.text: Uses direct load path (no ALU or IDB involvement)

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value loaded into IOT_TRANSFER.

constraints.text: 1 is selected when IO_READ_REQ is accepted.
2 is selected when IO_WRITE_REQ is accepted.
0 is selected when a completed transfer is cleared without replacement.
If completion and request acceptance occur at the same TP, the newly accepted direction is selected instead of 0.
Encoding 3 must never be selected.
The value has no effect unless IOT_TRANSFER_LOAD is asserted.

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value to load into the MA register

constraints.text: Only valid when MA_SRC == Control

fields.name: MDB_INPUT
fields.value_required_when: Any micro-operation listed below is selected

attributes.purpose: Provides data received from memory via the memory data bus (MDB).

constraints.text: Must be valid when sampled
Only used during memory read operations
Not interchangeable with IDB or DB sources

attributes.purpose: Specifies the value to load into the PC register

constraints.text: Only valid when PC_SRC == Control

attributes.description: Indicates that the CPU is requesting a memory read operation.

constraints.text: must not be asserted simultaneously with /WR
does not imply data transfer into any register
does not define MDB validity or timing behavior
does not select the memory address source
does not select the MDB data source
must be paired with [MEM_READ_TO_MB](../../03-microarchitecture/02-micro-operations.md#mem_read_to_mb) or DMA

attributes.description: Indicates that the CPU is requesting a memory write operation.

constraints.text: must not be asserted simultaneously with /RD
does not select the memory address source
does not select the MDB data source
must be paired with a valid memory-write μop or DMA
valid memory-write μops are:
[MEM_WRITE_FROM_MB](../../03-microarchitecture/02-micro-operations.md#mem_write_from_mb)
[MEM_WRITE_FROM_FP_SR](../../03-microarchitecture/02-micro-operations.md#mem_write_from_fp_sr)

attributes.description: Indicates that the CPU is in MS = DMA and has released normal CPU ownership of the memory interface.

constraints.text: must be generated only by the control word
must not be asserted during normal instruction execution
must not be asserted concurrently with CPU-initiated /RD or /WR
does not itself define DMA address, data, direction, or device selection
does not modify CPU architectural state
does not modify RUN or HLT_REQ
external DMA ownership and multi-device arbitration are outside CPU control and must be resolved before or during DMA service

attributes.description: Indicates that the CPU is performing an I/O read operation and will sample the System Data Bus (DB) during this timing state.

constraints.text: Must not be asserted concurrently with /DB_WRITE
Must not be asserted without DB_READ_TO_AC
CPU must not drive DB while /DB_READ is asserted
DB must be driven by at most one external device

attributes.description: Indicates that the CPU is performing an I/O write operation and will drive the System Data Bus (DB) during this timing state.

constraints.text: Must not be asserted concurrently with /DB_READ
Must not be asserted without DB_WRITE_FROM_AC
CPU is the sole driver of DB when this signal is asserted
External devices must not drive DB during this interval

attributes.description: System-wide reset signal asserted by CAF or an accepted front-panel CLEAR operation.

constraints.text: front-panel CLEAR is accepted only when RUN = 0
front-panel CLEAR is ignored when RUN = 1
one /INITIALIZE pulse is generated per distinct accepted front-panel CLEAR press
a held front-panel CLEAR input must not generate repeated /INITIALIZE pulses
front-panel CLEAR is re-armed only after the synchronized input is released
CAF has no effect unless execution reaches EXECUTE TP4
CAF and front-panel CLEAR produce the same /INITIALIZE action
/INITIALIZE does not modify II, CIFP, DIF, IF, DF, or IB
controller-specific initialized states are defined in the corresponding controller documents

attributes.description: Specifies the target I/O device address during execution of IOT instructions.

constraints.text: Meaningful to external controllers only while IOT_ACTIVE is asserted.
Must not be modified by a micro-operation.
Does not imply data transfer or direction.
Does not define device behavior.

attributes.description: Presents IR[2:0] unchanged to external I/O controllers during an external IOT.

constraints.text: Does not select a controller.
Does not directly determine DB direction.
Does not define controller behavior.
Must not be interpreted unless IOT_ACTIVE is asserted.
Must not be modified by a micro-operation.

attributes.description: Identifies execution of an external IOT and qualifies IOA, IOP, controller responses, and I/O wait behavior.

constraints.text: Does not itself cause data movement.
Does not itself cause controller state change.
Must be paired with IOA, IOP, TS, and TP according to the controller contract.
must be defined for all states at TS4
must not change outside TS4
must not be modified by μops

attributes.description: Specifies the next value of the RUN state.

constraints.text: must be defined in every control word
must not be computed outside the control store
must not be modified by μops
must be consumed as a committed state value through [RUN](../10-control-input-definitions/01-flags.md#run)

attributes.description: Specifies the next value of the halt-request pending state.

constraints.text: must be defined in every control word
must not be computed outside the control store
must not be modified by μops
must be consumed as a committed state value through [HLT_REQ](../10-control-input-definitions/01-flags.md#hlt_req)
